tracking: ADR-0322 (lane E7): API-only by the lane brief (master dispatch 2026-11-15: new routes go in the census with a KNOWN_UI_GAPS entry pointing at #453, no screens), recorded in ADR-0322 (As built, slice 2); the vendor usage pull settings screen is posted on #453

gaps.GET /v1/vendor-usage: reads the vendor usage pull policy, the vendor catalogue and every connector (credentials never returned)
gaps.PUT /v1/vendor-usage/policy: turns vendor usage pull on (settings_relax step-up, refused when air-gapped) or off, with a required reason
gaps.POST /v1/vendor-usage/connectors: registers a vendor usage connector (disabled) with its schema-validated configuration
gaps.PUT /v1/vendor-usage/connectors/:connect: changes a connector's configuration (backfill, the gateway's own key/project/workspace ids) and re-marks stored lines
stores or rotates a connector's vendor key (step-up, write-capable acknowledgement, encrypted, never returned)
gaps.DELETE /v1/vendor-usage/connectors/:conn: revokes a connector's vendor key and disables the connector (no step-up)
gaps.PUT /v1/vendor-usage/connectors/:connect: enables (step-up, needs a live credential) or disables a connector
gaps.POST /v1/vendor-usage/connectors/:connec: runs one pull now for a connector
gaps.GET /v1/vendor-usage/connectors/:connect: lists a connector's last 50 pull runs
